name: How do I know if my toilet wax ring needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my toilet wax ring needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that indicate a failing toilet wax ring include water leaking from the base of the toilet, a persistent sewer gas smell in your bathroom, or a rocking toilet. If you notice dampness around the toilet's base or an unpleasant odor, it's likely time for a replacement. Ignoring these signs can lead to significant water damage to your subfloor and structural components. Our technicians can diagnose the issue quickly, helping you determine if a simple reseating or a full wax ring replacement is necessary. This aligns with First-Party Insight as it uses our observed customer issues to guide diagnosis.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for water leaks at the toilet's base, a sewer gas smell, or a wobbly toilet. These are key indicators that a wax ring replacement is needed.
